integration_facts: Current schedule loader filters the public multi-season download to one season and stores schedule:<season>.
Existing cache keeps the previous snapshot on source-refresh failure.
Neutral-site information is explicit in the location field, but location is not currently a required schedule column.
1999 kickoff times are missing; 2000 onward timestamps parsed in the audit.
League has 31 teams through 2001 and 32 from 2002.
Historical relocations require OAK/LV, STL/LA and SD/LAC continuity; existing aliases only handle JAC/JAX and LAR/LA.
Schedule has no explicit final/in-progress status field.
The 2022 regular season has 271 games, including 16 each for BUF and CIN; fixed expected game counts would be inappropriate.

finality_audit.conclusion: One game observed with blank midgame scores and populated later scores; supports but does not guarantee final-only publication.
